_about: Known cuda_spill_guard violations: kernel instances over their ALLOWED allowance on the base that are inherited and not yet fixed. Per architecture, each by its exact instance name (tools/check_cuda_spills.py instance_key) with the bytes measured. A violation listed here at or below its bytes passes as known; a new instance, or a listed one above its bytes, fails. Another CUDA toolkit may list a slightly different set of instances; add what it measures here, never raise a number to hide growth. sm_60 has no baseline (about 400 violations, nothing measured per instance): the guard says so and its violations fail as before.
